items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts.
items.implication: First game without Hurts; McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers but thin RB.
items.opportunity: Boost to DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks in pass-heavy script possible.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT in Sunday FantasyFootball injuries roundup.
items.why: Quad; third straight miss; confirmed across reports.
items.implication: Braelon Allen handles bulk workload vs NE.
items.opportunity: Jets RB handcuff/backup elevation; limited WR help with AD Mitchell also OUT.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers.
items.why: Official team ruling confirmed by Schefter; lengthy Eagles injury list.
items.implication: Major downgrade; Tanner McKee starts at QB with thin RB room (4th-string Dameon Pierce).
items.opportunity: Increased work for remaining PHI RBs and pass-catchers (DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks).

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle; misses second straight game; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.implication: Downgrade Ravens pass game; Huntley limits ceiling.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers remains viable WR2; Mark Andrews more volatile.

items.text: Tyler Warren (groin) was a Friday addition as questionable.
items.why: Groin injury during Friday individual drills; sudden add.
items.implication: Monitor closely; key IND TE usage at risk.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more to other IND pass-catchers (Pittman? Downs, Pierce).

items.text: Unclear on questionable AJ Brown (ankle) as of now; practiced limited all week earlier than expected.
items.why: Ankle; limited all week but status unclear; Rapoport notes earlier-than-expected limited practice.
items.implication: Game-time feel; monitor for return boost to NE pass game.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more targets to other NE WRs/RBs; if IN, high-upside WR1.

items.text: David Montgomery listed OUT; did not travel to London.
items.why: Groin; official OUT for Texans at Jaguars.
items.implication: Woody Marks leads HOU backfield in tough run-D matchup but with receiving work.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT along with Tyquan Thornton.
items.why: Hamstring/knee; bye insufficient for full recovery.
items.implication: Mahomes targets shift; Worthy primary upside.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy WR3 upside; deeper KC WRs flex.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game.
items.why: Cleared; full availability vs KC despite other Chargers outs (Alt etc).
items.implication: Full role expected; key LAC pass-catcher.
items.opportunity: Stable WR2/3 usage with OL injuries possibly increasing pass volume.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed with high-ankle sprain; practiced this week but surprised he could; NE plays Thursday next so may be more for availability check. Levitan also unclear on Q status.
items.why: High-ankle sprain per player; practiced but risk for short week ahead.
items.implication: Risky start; volume if active vs Jets but high-ankle often lingers.
items.opportunity: If OUT, NE RB tryouts (Bentley etc) or other backs elevate; Rhamondre if available.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams.
items.implication: ARI RB committee shift; less competition or role change for others.
items.opportunity: Potential uptick for remaining ARI backs.

items.text: Caleb Williams Q but bunch of Q tags seem more like probable including Caleb; full practice earlier.
items.why: Official Q after full practice; Levitan views as likely to play.
items.implication: Expect start vs ATL; solid spot with pass-D matchup.
items.opportunity: Bears pass-catchers (Odunze, Moore, Loveland) if he plays.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; Evans is my WR4 for Week 6. Soft matchup for pass catchers.
items.why: Washington defense nightmare for WRs; high ranking WR4.
items.implication: Strong start/sit upgrade in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs weak secondary.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5, elite usage vs ARI leaky run D), Javonte Williams, Rhamondre; hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts, J.K. Dobbins, Bo Nix, Justin Herbert.
items.why: Volume + matchups for loves (run-D leaks, goal-line); ugly matchups/QB issues for hates.
items.opportunity: Kyren elite usage; Javonte goal-line role.
